name: Kentin
source:
Kentin is very nice and helpful, but a bit clingy. He's a friend of the heroine. At the beginning, Kentin admits he transferred to Sweet Amoris to be with her. Later, it's revealed that Kentin's father is in the military. He transfers Kentin out of Sweet Amoris after hearing Amber and her friends were bullying him, and enrolls him into a military boot camp instead.
Kentin comes back over time.

Likes: cookies, teddy bears
Dislikes: spicy food, Amber
